title: Hypercontractivity of Independent Sums
statement: Let $(��)$ be a probability space, and let $X,Y$ be real-valued random variables on it. If $X$ and $Y$ are both $(p,q,ho)$-hypercontractive and are independent, then $X+Y$ is $(p,q,ho)$-hypercontractive.
replaced: Let $X,Y$ be independent real random variables on a probability space. If both satisfy $H_{p,q,\rho}$, then $X+Y$ also satisfies $H_{p,q,\rho}$. Write $H_{p,q,\rho}(X)$ for $1\le p\le q\le\infty$, $0\le\rho<1$, $X\in L^q(\mu)$, and $\|a+\rho bX\|_q\le\|a+bX\|_p$ for all $a,b\in\bbr$.
